customer_persona: Rajesh Kumar is an anxious, family-oriented customer who ordered an electric kettle for his elderly parents and is frustrated by an unexpected shipping delay.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling ShopEase customer care. My name is Neha Gupta. Please note that this call is being recorded for quality monitoring and training purposes. How may I assist you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi Neha, this is Rajesh Kumar. I am really frustrated right now. I placed an order for a Prestige Electric Kettle 1.5L which was guaranteed to be delivered yesterday, but nobody turned up, and there was zero communication!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I am truly sorry to hear about the delay, Mr. Kumar. I will certainly look into this for you. To ensure your account security, could you please confirm your Order ID along with the last four digits of your registered mobile number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, the Order ID is ORD-81121 and the last four digits of my mobile number are 8633.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for confirming those details, Mr. Kumar. I completely understand how frustrating it is to wait at home expecting a delivery that does not arrive. You have reached the right person, and I will take personal ownership to resolve this for you.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I appreciate that, Neha. I needed the kettle urgently to boil drinking water for my elderly parents, so the delay caused real inconvenience.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I completely understand the urgency in this situation. To help me check the courier logs accurately, did you receive any message or call from the delivery partner yesterday?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, there was no call or SMS at all. The app showed 'out for delivery' around noon, and by 8 PM it just changed back to 'in transit at local hub'.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Understood. To check the exact status with our local hub dispatch manager and ensure your parcel moves out immediately, may I place your call on a brief hold for about one minute?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, please check and let me know what is happening.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you so much for holding, Mr. Kumar. I truly appreciate your patience while I was looking into this.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I coordinated directly with our hub supervisor. The Prestige Electric Kettle has been assigned to a priority logistics rider for immediate dispatch. Also, because of the one-day shipping delay past your promised delivery window, I have processed 1,000 rupees as wallet credit directly into your ShopEase account as compensation.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, that is helpful. But when exactly can I expect the delivery executive to reach my home today?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The delivery executive will bring the package straight to your doorstep today, and you will receive an SMS alert with their direct contact number as soon as the van leaves the gate.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Alright, as long as it arrives before evening, that works fine for me. Thank you for looking into it so promptly.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: To recap, your Prestige Electric Kettle for order ORD-81121 is expedited for delivery today, and the wallet credit has been added to your ShopEase balance. Aside from this, is there anything else I may help you with today, Mr. Kumar?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that resolves my concern. Thank you, Neha.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You are most welcome, Mr. Kumar. Thank you for calling ShopEase. We appreciate your patience and hope you have a pleasant day ahead!
